mapper.select: select count(*) from fin_bom_title left join fin_product on fin_bom_title.fin_product_id = fin_product.id where fin_bom_title.id in ( select distinct fin_bom.bom_title_id from fin_bom where (productId,vault) in (select * from( select product.id,vault from product where concat(product.`name`,product.material_number) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{str},'%') and deleteSign = 0 union all select fin_product.id,vault from fin_product where concat(fin_product.fin_product_name,fin_product.fin_material_number) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{str},'%') and deleteSign = 0 ) as a) ) and fin_product.deleteSign = 0
